entries.title: Membership Rates Through October 31, 2026 (Tier A / Tier B / Loyalty)
entries.content:
CURRENT monthly facility membership rates — good THROUGH OCTOBER 31, 2026 ONLY. Starting November 1, 2026, use the "Membership Fee Changes (Oct 1 & Nov 1, 2026) and the Bank Draft Discount" SOP instead.

Rates (Tier A / Tier B / Tier C-Loyalty):
- Adult (24+): $50 / $45 / $40
- Single Adult Family: $65 / $60 / $55
- Family: $80 / $75 / $70
- Young Adult (18–23): $25 (no Tier B or C)
- Youth: $15 (no Tier B or C)

Loyalty Rate: Adult and Family members who stay one consecutive year qualify for the Loyalty Rate, saving $10 per month.

Program Memberships (program registration only, NO facility access), charged annually: $25 individual / $50 family through September 30, 2026. Starting October 1, 2026 they're $35 individual / $70 family (per the fee SOP).

The printed branch membership flyers show these same prices, so they are only accurate through October 31, 2026.

Source: branch membership flyers (Lighthouse, Lohse, Northwest, Ott, YMCA of Southern Arizona), Sept 2026.
entries.attachmentTitle: YMCA of Southern Arizona membership flyer

entries.title: Membership Policies — Family Definition, Cancellation Notice, Financial Assistance
entries.content:
- Family and Single Adult Family memberships include 1 or 2 adults plus dependents 23 years and younger living in the same household.
- A 30-day WRITTEN cancellation notice is required for all membership types.
- Financial Assistance is available — members apply online at tucsonymca.org/financial-assistance.
- Amenities vary by location (see each branch's info).
- YMCA of Southern Arizona main phone: 520-623-9622.

Source: branch membership flyers, Sept 2026.

entries.title: Branch Info — Lighthouse City/YMCA (hours, phone, amenities, membership flyer)
entries.content:
Phone: 520-795-9725 · tucsonymca.org/lighthouse

Wellness Center hours (per the membership flyer): Monday–Friday 6am–8pm, Saturday 7am–4pm, Sunday 12pm–4pm.
(Note: the website lists Friday as 6am–6pm — if it matters for a member, confirm Friday closing time with the branch.)

Amenities:
- Pool: seasonal OUTDOOR pool with aquatics classes and open swim
- Group exercise: Zumba, BodyPump, Yoga, SilverSneakers, etc.
- Cardio, strength and free-weight areas: treadmills, bikes, strength machines, dumbbells, squat rack, etc.
- Discounted youth programs: sports, Y Kids Nights, Family Nights, camps
- Personal training

The attached membership flyer's PRICES are only good through Oct 31, 2026 (after that it's hidden automatically).

Source: Lighthouse membership flyer, Sept 2026.
